## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Environment & Hardware
- **OS**: [e.g., Windows 11, macOS Sequoia, Ubuntu 24.04, Android 14, iOS 18]
- **Browser**: [e.g., Chrome 130, Firefox 131, Safari 18, Edge]
- **Mode**: [ ] 3D Voxel World  [ ] 2D Accessible View
- **GPU / Device**: [e.g., Apple M2, NVIDIA RTX 4070, Intel Iris Xe, Adreno 740]
- **Display DPR**: [e.g., 1.0, 1.25, 2.0]

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Press key or click on '...'
3. Move player towards station '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened (e.g., player sunk into ground, shader failed to compile, FPS dropped below 20).

## Screenshots / Video
If applicable, attach screenshots or a screen recording to help explain your problem.

## Browser Console Errors / WebGL Logs
```text
Paste any console errors or WebGL shader info logs here
```

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., settings modal quality tier selection, whether sound effects played, etc.).
